title: Reproduce approved LR-FHSS decoding offline
description:
Reproduce acquisition, synchronization and packet recovery for one human-approved receiver/tool environment against the provenance-qualified captured corpus. Declare any supplied start time, DR, CFO or profile information rather than presenting configured decoding as blind acquisition.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Offline execution only after affirmative lrfhss.09 clearance for the exact code, dataset and tools. No hardware, contacts, purchases, license acceptance or radio transmissions. A successful offline packet decode is not real-time or embedded RX qualification.
acceptance_criteria: Recovered bytes match independent lrfhss.03 transmitter ground truth. Report every attempted capture, failure, unsupported mode and required manual assumption. Record executable/tool revisions and commands. Missing oracle data or a closed permission gate without affirmative approval prevents a pass.
